say:3:1120322001:1.text: Yes, well... There's also... Hmm, you know... that thing? The one you mentioned earlier...?
say:3:1120322001:1.source_cn: 这个……那个……就是那个嘛……那个，各位都知道的……你...

say:4:1120322002:1.text: Oh, I'm sorry! I was so happy that I almost forgot about your payment! What do you want?
say:4:1120322002:1.source_cn: 对不起，我只顾着高兴，忘记了。请说，你需要什么报酬？

say:5:1120322003:1.text: Don't worry, we gave you our word that we would repay you for your help.
say:5:1120322003:1.source_cn: 你放心，承诺给你的报酬，我们不会食言。

say:6:1120322004:1.text: Ah, it's all so embarrassing to bring up...
say:6:1120322004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这个说来有点不好意思……

say:9:1120322005:1.text: Why's he acting so coy all of a sudden? I have a bad feeling about this meerkat...
say:9:1120322005:1.source_cn: 这只狐獴怎么忽然笑得这么羞涩，让我有种不祥的预感……

say:10:1120322006:1.text: Heehee! Rest assured, everyone! My remuneration is quite affordable for the likes of you!
say:10:1120322006:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，各位放心，我的要求非常朴实无华，各位一定轻松就能...

say:11:1120322007:1.text: All I ask for is enough food to bring back to the children in my clan. Nothing more!
say:11:1120322007:1.source_cn: 我就是想要给部落里的孩子们带点食物回去，仅此而已。

say:12:1120322008:1.text: Is that it? If all you want is food, then leave it to us!
say:12:1120322008:1.source_cn: 原来只是食物啊，没问题，包在我们身上了！

choice_prompt:13:1120322008.text: Is that it? If all you want is food, then leave it to us!
choice_prompt:13:1120322008.source_cn: 原来只是食物啊，没问题，包在我们身上了！

say:14:1120322009:1.text: A wonderful question, my dear mage! What I would like is a meerkat's most sought-after delight—
say:14:1120322009:1.source_cn: 还是这位魔法师大人问得好！我想要的就是对我们狐獴来说，...
say:14:1120322009:1.male: A wonderful question, my dear mage! What I would like is a meerkat's most sought-after delight—
say:14:1120322009:1.female: A wonderful question, my dear mage! What I would like is a meerkat's most sought-after delight—

say:17:1120322012:1.text: I-I-I hardly consider that to be normal food! D-Do you really eat those?!
say:17:1120322012:1.source_cn: 你你你你们竟然吃蜘蛛蛋……这根本就不是“普通的食物”吧！

say:20:1120322013:1.text: Spider eggs... Those are hard to obtain.

say:21:1120322014:1.text: I beg to differ, my friends! If anyone can easily acquire spider eggs, it's your powerful party of adventurers! After all, your first trial...
say:21:1120322014:1.source_cn: 不麻烦不麻烦，如果是你们的话，肯定很轻松就能拿到的！毕...

say:22:1120322015:1.text: Looks like we don't have a choice... I wouldn't have agreed so quickly if I knew this was what you wanted!
say:22:1120322015:1.source_cn: 没办法了……早知道之前不那么轻易答应了！

say:23:1120322016:1.text: Let's just go gather spider eggs for him...

say:24:1120322017:0.text: Excellent! I knew you would keep your word, my friends!
say:24:1120322017:0.source_cn: 好嘞！我就知道几位信守承诺的大人们一定会答应的！

say:25:1120322018:1.text: I'll just stay here and await your triumphant return, yes?
say:25:1120322018:1.source_cn: 那在下就在这里，等候各位满载而归了！

choice:13:0:1.text: Wait, what exactly do you meerkats eat?
choice:13:0:1.male: Wait, what exactly do you meerkats eat?
choice:13:0:1.female: Wait, what exactly do you meerkats eat?

choice:13:1:2.text: Wait, what kind of food do you want?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 等等，你想要带什么食物回去？
